scaling.position: after fixed Smooth0.5/H128, before dynamic per-token A4
scaling.forward: F.linear(Q_A4(Z/D;ratio), BF16(decoded trainable VQ books/row gains * D), bias)
scaling.backward: Preserve completed per-channel stored-weight/amax ratio,input,D surrogate; additionally return compensated BF16 weight adjoint through existing DecodedWeight into FP32 books/log row gains.
scaling.storage: additional FP32 log2 scales; original integer B32 exponents unchanged; no rounded deployment substitution
scaling.training_evaluation: same compensated BF16 weight path; backward recomputes transient compensated matrix to avoid per-step dense copies; final eval caches same compensated weights
scaling.original_weight_content: Train books and log row gains; keep VQ indices and original B32 exponents frozen; compensation rounding measured against current unscaled decoded Wq.
scaling.initialization: original C8 rho1.5 baseline, log2D=0 ratio=1; no B32 warm start

gradient_coupling.forward: Completed per-channel compensated BF16 forward, with Wq refreshed from trainable VQ masters; no new quantizer or loss.
gradient_coupling.tie_rule: torch.amax equal-share subgradient; signed maximum mask int8 and per-token integer tie count
gradient_coupling.group_gradient: same per-channel corrected terms, reduced over rows only; sqrt(rows*7), layer centering
gradient_coupling.input_gradient: include dL/dm * dm/dv before D^-1 and inverse Smooth/H128; necessary for upstream D through subsequent layers
gradient_coupling.unchanged: all absmax/input chains, stored-weight LSQ/BF16 coefficient approximation, ratio normalization, learning rates, bounds, Adam reset, loss/data/seeds/shared teacher
gradient_coupling.independent_check: autograd live-amax STE reference must pass and missing-max-chain surrogate must fail its distinguishing fixture; zero/ties/tail and forward/cache parity checked inside PBS; new weight adjoint checked against native BF16 compensated F.linear and original VQ decoder; original x/ratio/D gradients preserved.
